title: Europe
scene: 1983 Sweden: progressive-leaning, self-produced heavy metal and hard rock
notes: Raw early metal mixes fast guitar leads, organ-like keys, fantasy narratives and acoustic breathing space.

title: Wings of Tomorrow
scene: 1984 Swedish melodic heavy rock; Stockholm Polar Studios
notes: Heavier guitar runs meet more melodic choruses, keyboard colouring and acoustic ballads.

title: The Final Countdown
scene: 1986 Swedish melodic arena rock, transatlantic major-label production
influenced_by: Iron Maiden (The Number of the Beast)|UFO (Lights Out)|David Bowie (Space Oddity)
notes: An oversized synth fanfare frames soaring arena guitars, driving rock choruses and ballads.

title: Out of This World
scene: 1988 melodic arena hard rock; London studios and polished US producer
notes: Kee Marcello guitar solos weave through layered keyboards, polished hooks and romantic slow songs.
